title: •Yoda
caption: •Yoda (V)
game_text: May deploy to Dagobah. Retrieve 3 Force (ignore objective game text that prevents retrieval) when a Jedi Test is completed (may not be canceled except by Secret Plans). Retrieve no Force from Save You It Can. May ▼ one Yoda’s Gimer Stick.
lore: Help you I can, yes. For 800 years have I trained Jedi. Judge me by my size do you? Mm? And well you should not! For my ally is the Force... and a powerful ally it is.

notes: Unique. Slip prints the ▼ triangle where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; curly apostrophe in Yoda’s. Third stat box JEDI MASTER (label only). Icon column empty (only the set sphere). Affiliation: the printed card's top-left disc is the Light Jedi (lightsaber blade) icon, not the Rebel starbird; wiki subtype 'Jedi Master'; recorded as Rebel (the Dagobah Rebel-style frame; Yoda counts as a Rebel character) — check if the renderer needs a different frame. Lore matches the scan ('...' printed as three spaced dots). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible. Modern: V7-L-yoda.gif (745 px); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
